title: Cosmic Eye Volcano
description: A massive cosmic eye dominates the starry sky, its iris filled with a swirling galaxy and a silhouetted figure standing at the center of a black pupil. In the foreground, a red-haired woman with flowing hair stands with her back to the viewer, emitting fiery orange energy, while a volcanic landscape erupts with lava flows and floating glowing blue orbs below the eye.
prompt: Surreal cosmic scene featuring an enormous stylized eye filling the upper portion of the image, its iris a vibrant swirling galaxy of purple, blue and orange with a small silhouetted human figure standing inside the black pupil. Below the eye is a volcanic landscape with flowing orange lava. In the left foreground a woman with long flowing red hair faces the eye, her body radiating bright orange and blue energy bursts. Several large translucent blue spheres with glowing trails float in the air between the eye and the volcano, dramatic swirling colorful nebula clouds in the sky, highly detailed digital painting style.
